name: vibeknow-cli
description: Turn a document, a web page, a slide deck, or text pasted straight into the chat into a narrated video. Five creation modes — freeform, illustrated, page-by-page slide walkthrough, hand-drawn animation, one-shot — or lock your own script and have it narrated verbatim. Follow progress while it runs, then read the script, adjust subtitles and background music for free, and export the MP4 straight back into the conversation.

cn.gourd.gwork.readme:
## VibeKnow CLI CLI 连接器

厂商官方 `vibeknow-cli@0.10.1`，扫码/浏览器授权，内置 1 套官方技能。

### 连接方式

1. 点击「连接」，GWork 自动准备 Node 运行时并安装官方 CLI；
2. 弹窗展示授权链接/二维码，按厂商页面完成扫码或浏览器确认；
3. 授权完成后自动连接。凭据由官方 CLI 自管，GWork 不接触 token。

技能包来源：厂商公开 CLI 包随附技能文档（公开仓库缓存副本）；许可见各技能目录 LICENSE。
